scope: New authored synthetic engineering-memory validation and same-host growth experiment. Not unseen production data, LLM answer accuracy, an external-product benchmark, or a universal complexity proof.

freeze.phase_one: Save this plan and the complete generator/question/gold module remotely before formal retrieval. Root may review engineering feasibility, but observed candidate answers must not change source facts, questions, required evidence or thresholds.
freeze.phase_two: Before any official baseline or candidate query, remotely save the exact plan, generator, runner and evaluator-integrity tests together. Runtime commits, hashes, native binaries and all read-only helper dependencies are independently bound.
freeze.helper_boundary: Only generic Git/runtime identity, safe restoration, raw journals, source-coordinate validation patterns and resource helpers may be reused. Their exact bytes are frozen dependencies. No old protocol, old question, old gold, old score or old result is edited or relabelled.
freeze.pre_freeze_checks: Pure source generation, expected counts, age/layout/mutation invariants, supplied-response scoring, instrumentation on artificial SQLite tables, schedule and tiny generic ingest/storage checks. Zero official new recall/directory queries. Actual integrity test counts stay separate from formal quality denominators.
freeze.retention: Keep every failed, interrupted, invalid-instrumentation and resource-limited attempt. No partial attempt is silently pooled with its replacement; only one accepted complete block per registered slot contributes fixed-n statistics.
freeze.independence: The experiment owner does not inspect candidate runtime implementation or change gold in response to candidate results. This authored development set is public after freeze and is not called a production holdout. Any later change needs a new protocol and retains this version's outputs.

source.construction: All original pages are made by MemoryBook.ingest using explicit turn segmentation. Replacements use ingest with the same project/session IDs; deletions use public delete_session. No direct population, replacement or deletion of source tables.
source.semantic_controls: Repeated human task names and exact identifiers occur across distinct project IDs with different approved values and boundary facts. Same-project sibling namespaces/units, quoted examples, unfulfilled conditions, denied values, withdrawn proposals, no-change reports and equal-time contradictory approvals coexist. None may be silently erased from the archive.
source.gold_access: Workers receive queries, explicit project IDs and request settings. Required source/session/turn quotes are used only by the evaluator after calls. Directory traversal follows returned locators without gold-guided selection.
source.scope_boundary: Turn segmentation isolates source/page growth from adaptive segmentation. No semantic model, arbitrary prose authority, concurrent workload, decade-long process uptime or physical-storage-cold claim.

axes.age: Two fresh 2048-page databases ingest identical source text and IDs in the same order. Only created_at dates shift uniformly by 3650 days; no repeated reingestion or layout changes are allowed.
axes.foreign: Hold all 1504 target pages fixed while total pages grow through 2048, 10240, 51200, 100000 and 200000. The three inactive targets remain 32/256/1024 pages. Required evidence, source text and source IDs remain unchanged. Changed retrieval ranks or corpus-dependent scores are not by themselves fabricated evidence.
axes.own: From foreign-51200, hold its 49696 foreign pages fixed and add 48800 maintenance pages to the three growing projects, reaching 100000 total pages. Inactive histories remain unchanged. Own-history growth is not conflated with foreign growth.
axes.layout: Rebuild the identical 100000-page logical corpus with a deterministic source-ID hash insertion order so every target's sources are interleaved across the archive. Preserve logical source/page IDs and validate changed physical rowid spans.
axes.replacement: At 100000 pages replace three mutable-config sources in the growing projects through ingest. Each new approved value is the preregistered old allocation plus 1000. Source IDs remain; source text and dates change.
axes.deletion: Delete those three one-page mutable-config sources with delete_session. Actual page count becomes 99997. Their former quotes/IDs are never valid current evidence. Three corresponding questions become missing-evidence controls under the predeclared gold.
axes.foreign_writes: At both reference-2048 and foreign-200000, retain an open reader and perform 20 separately committed 32-page foreign additions. After each, query all three fixed projects with cache allowed, result cache bypassed, and a new connection. End counts are 2688 and 200640; these are labelled lifecycle subphases, not misreported as unchanged 2048/200000 archives.
axes.warm_mutations: On separately restored interleaved-100000 copies, first prime and verify cache entries for the three mutable configurations. Replace and delete them one at a time, checking the first and repeated post-write response against the current source state. A cached old source, resurrected deleted page or stale value is a correctness failure.

retrieval.repeated_question_boundary: These are 48 authored recall prompts and 6 directory prompts. Stages, cache modes, arms, repetitions and mutations do not create independent questions. Before-deletion answerable count is 42; three predeclared lifecycle questions become missing after deletion.
retrieval.current_first: Require the qualified current source first only for current and review_guard single-source questions. Multi-source completeness does not require forcing the current policy above a relevant boundary source. Equal-time conflict questions require both sources without a unique-winner assertion.
retrieval.missing: Report nonempty-context rate separately. Related cited context is not calibrated abstention. A comparable_declaration/unique-current assertion for the absent requested field is a failure; not_assessed/no_matching/no_comparable is bounded evidence metadata, not proof of whole-archive absence.

directory.path: search_directory -> returned section -> returned page -> read. Apply explicit project scope at every step, preserve partial traces on error, and score original read text rather than locator summaries.

measurement.backend: Explicit native for the main experiment, with exact imported package path and extension hash for each runtime. A fallback is not silently accepted. Python correctness replay is a separate named matrix if executed.

cache_modes.adoption_first_request: Before any query on each restored baseline-built image, measure MemoryBook open and the first request separately and jointly. Rotate the three fixed-project probes across six rounds, giving two first-use observations per probe/arm/stage. Report every observation and maxima; n=2 is not a stable p95 claim.
cache_modes.index_ready_result_cold: After recorded priming of the exact performance requests, delete only recall_cache outside the API timer. Call with use_cache=True and require cache_hit false. Any runtime-derived index or helper reuse remains part of this explicitly index-ready mode.
cache_modes.warm_result_cache: Immediately follow each result-cold recall with three identical use_cache=True calls and require cache_hit true. Preserve all original responses and quality scores.
cache_modes.fresh_connection_first_request: For each of three fixed-project probes and five repetitions per round, create a new MemoryBook connection and make its first request with use_cache=False. Measure open, request and their sum separately. This explicitly includes connection-local derived-index creation in first-request latency.
cache_modes.directory: Full uncached directory/navigation/read chain, including each API needed to reach original evidence. A prior priming request is labelled; no result-cache hit is inferred.
cache_modes.foreign_write: After each of 20 foreign ingests, observe cache-allowed recall, result-bypass recall and fresh-connection first recall for the three fixed projects. Cache survival is observed rather than required: recomputation can be correct, but its work and latency must still meet the foreign-growth gates.

measurement.isolation: No baseline/candidate workers overlap. Before every block restore a byte-verified baseline-built snapshot into a fresh owned working database. Candidate-added indexes never contaminate baseline. New-connection tests use the same arm's original source state, not another arm's modified schema. Record first open/migration/query cost rather than excluding index construction from the report.
measurement.instrumentation: Separate work-probe blocks install SQLite progress and trace instrumentation on every measured connection and count cursor rows yielded. Count VM progress at interval 1, statement executions, cursor rows, response candidate_count, returned hits/source refs, and query plans. These instrumented elapsed times are not mixed into ordinary wallclock groups. Any uninstrumented extra connection or incompatible factory is reported as unavailable/invalid, not zero work.
measurement.instrumentation_boundary: SQLite VM instructions and yielded rows do not count all internal FTS C posting-list work, native computation or CPU instructions. Combine them with uninstrumented process CPU, wallclock, returned/candidate counts and plans. No claim of constant physical work follows from flat VM counts alone.
measurement.storage_and_resources: Record main/WAL/SHM sizes, database page/freelist counts, TEMP page_count/page_size/freelist_count, all measured connections, process lifetime peak RSS, CPU, minor/major faults and host load. TEMP logical page allocation is not identical to resident bytes. Record immediately after initialization, first access, index priming, writes and before closing connections; do not hide temporary indexes by measuring only after close.
measurement.write_costs: Time every real ingest and delete separately from queries. For fresh 2048 and 200000 source builds, execute the same source/order through each runtime in separate processes and record total and per-session wall/CPU costs. One full build per arm/stage is a cost observation, not a repeated-build latency distribution. Lifecycle writes provide repeated 32-page batch and replacement/deletion distributions.
measurement.statistics: Per arm/stage/query/mode retain n, p50, nearest-rank p95, min/max and six matched round medians. Cold, warm, directory and fresh-connection groups never pool. Primary query n=30 cold/directory/fresh-connection and n=90 warm; foreign-write modes n=120 per probe/arm/size. Instrumentation has n=3 separate probes, not latency samples. Every completed response is scored after the timer, including failed-quality fast responses.
measurement.host_boundary: Baseline861 and candidate run on the same new host with the same seed/backend. Record Python, SQLite, compiler/native hash and CPU. Filesystem restoration may warm OS caches; no privileged cache flush or OS-cold claim. Do not reuse v0.13 absolute timing from a different host or SQLite build.

expected_call_inventory.count_boundary: A directory chain is one primary observation with all its underlying API responses retained, not one primitive API call. Ingest/delete/open operations have their own counts. Final runner describe must derive and exactly match these loops before remote freeze.

acceptance.priority: Correctness and complete original evidence first; performance, startup and resource costs are separate gates, never substituted for correctness.
acceptance.integrity: All source/import/hash/snapshot/matrix checks pass. All main stages and lifecycle blocks must complete. A timeout, missing or invalid block is not a successful scale result.
acceptance.quality: Zero source-coordinate, invented-text, cross-project, deleted-source or context-budget errors across all recorded responses. Every new answerable quality case must contain all required spans. Current/review_guard cases require the current source first. Conflict sources must both be present and must not be labelled a unique current declaration. Missing cases must not claim a comparable unique current declaration. Keep the nonempty-context diagnostic visible. All former v0.13 complete gold cases remain complete in its separately bound unchanged-protocol replay.

foreign_growth.comparison: For every fixed-project performance query, compare 200000 with 2048 on the candidate. Both logical target histories are identical. Apply to all relevant index-ready recall and directory probes, and separately to fresh-connection and post-foreign-write modes. Inspect intermediate 10240/51200/100000 points; endpoint success does not erase a failed intermediate bound.
foreign_growth.foreign_write_reference: Compare each post-write mode at the large workload with that same mode after the same batch ordinal at the small workload. Source facts must remain correct even when an implementation invalidates caches globally.
foreign_growth.claim_boundary: Passing supports these finite observed growth bounds, not an O(1) theorem, universal latency SLA or storage-cold statement. First-use, repeated-open and post-write results must be reported alongside index-ready gains.

same_host_improvement.scope: For index-ready/result-cold and full-directory fixed-project groups at 200k, require at least 20% lower candidate pooled p50 and no p95 increase beyond 1ms compared with baseline861. All other groups, including slower own-history/fresh/warm groups, remain reported. Passing this gate alone does not satisfy foreign-growth or startup gates.

costs.boundary: First-adoption samples rotate first target and remain n=2 per fixed target; report maxima, not a stable p95. TEMP allocation, full process RSS and persistent size are separate. A one-time migration/first-index cost is disclosed even when later queries improve.

decision_labels.scoped_objectives_met: All integrity, quality, finite foreign-growth, same-host improvement and startup/write/space cost gates pass with the full registered matrix.
decision_labels.limited_evidence_only: Quality passes but any growth, improvement or cost gate fails. Report precise benefits and failed conditions; do not claim the user's unfinished response-time objective is completed.
decision_labels.correctness_not_accepted: Any required quality/source/cached-mutation condition fails. Preserve failures and correct runtime under unchanged protocol before a later attempt.
decision_labels.insufficient_evidence: Any required stage, source binding, instrumented-work group or matrix block is missing/invalid/resource-limited. No extrapolation from a smaller achieved archive.

limits.on_limit: Save started/completed events and every original partial response; record actual pages and the precise stop reason. List all unexecuted cells. SIGALRM is a soft Python deadline; a parent worker timeout supplies the separate hard process limit.

evidence.raw: Append-only started events, compact observations and complete original API packets in individually compressed gzip members, including directory traces, errors, source refs, cache flags, work counters, plans and source/gold scores. Never replace original responses with summaries.
evidence.sources: Record generated source/order hashes, canonical source-table hashes, actual pages/projects/sessions, per-target rowid spans, snapshot hashes, all runtime Git/source/native identities and every evaluator dependency hash. Reconstruction uses the frozen source generator, never a candidate-provided answer.
evidence.resource_separation: Open, first query, priming, ordinary timing, instrumented work, writes, checkpointing, restoration, scoring and serialization have distinct fields. CPU/RSS boundaries and instrument overhead are visible.
evidence.storage: Keep only run-owned working databases and necessary parent snapshots while measuring. Large reproducible snapshots may be pruned only after all dependent blocks and raw evidence are durable; preserve hashes and reconstruction recipe. Their exclusion from final ZIPs must be stated.
evidence.legacy: The unchanged v013 protocol separately compares its originally registered baseline8044 with the new candidate on the new host. Its old gold is a regression gate; it is not relabelled as a baseline861 v13-to-v14 timing experiment. This v014 protocol owns that new paired comparison.
